aaaErrors.possibleResolutions:
The subscriber's member ID is either missing or invalid.
• Check the `subscriber.memberId`.
• Ensure the member ID doesn't include the [Card Issuer Identifier](https://www.stedi.com/docs/healthcare/eligibility-troubleshooting#card-issuer-identifier-80840).
• If you can't locate the correct member ID, try running an [insurance discovery check](https://www.stedi.com/docs/healthcare/insurance-discovery) to retrieve the patient's benefits information instead.
